# Collaboration Conventions (generated by lbkit; supplement with this repository's actual conventions)

This repository uses its project logbook as the shared entry point for goals, tasks, authorization, and acceptance, wired to the skills, contracts, and CLI shared by [lbkit](.lbkit/README.md). Role titles can be configured in the `roles` section of `lbkit-agents.yaml` to match this repository's culture (e.g., Admiral / Captain / Crew); titles do not change permission boundaries.

## Role Division

- **Human owner**: holds the goals, risk acceptance, and irreversible decisions. The human personally maintains the goal and todo text in the logbook; agents must never write or reorder them on the human's behalf.
- **Coordinator**: maintains each logbook's shared state, dependencies, and acceptance; plans and dispatches well-bounded work packages to executor agents, then writes verified results back to the logbook.
- **Executor agent**: delivers work packages within the authorized scope and an isolated work tree, attaching verifiable evidence; results, scope, and evidence are all mandatory.

Plan confirmation is not execution authorization; agents never write logbook entries owned by the human. Authorization, evidence, and human gates are contract terms, not options — see the [coordination contract](docs/coordination.md), [evidence rules](docs/evidence.md), and [lifecycle](docs/lifecycle.md).

Repositories or directories not listed here must never be accessed; to expand the scope, first state the goal and purpose and obtain explicit human confirmation.

## Entry Points by Task

| Request | Skill |
|---|---|
| Create or refresh the `.lbkit` submodule and local entry points | [lb-init](.agents/skills/lb-init/SKILL.md) |
| Initialize the project logbook from the template | [lb-scaffold](.agents/skills/lb-scaffold/SKILL.md) |
| Review goals, draft todos, design phases and work packages | [lb-plan](.agents/skills/lb-plan/SKILL.md) |
| Read-only pre-check: route planning and feasibility analysis | [lb-preflight](.agents/skills/lb-preflight/SKILL.md) |
| Advance, resume, and monitor execution within the authorized scope | [lb-push](.agents/skills/lb-push/SKILL.md) |
| Verify evidence, maintain records, record manual close-out | [lb-update](.agents/skills/lb-update/SKILL.md) |
| Observe logbooks and the control plane, produce a status brief | [lb-status](.agents/skills/lb-status/SKILL.md) |

A skill name does not expand operation permissions; `lb-push` means project advancement, not Git push.

## Environment and Files

- The shared implementation and instructions come from the `.lbkit/` submodule; for background see [.lbkit/AGENTS.md](.lbkit/AGENTS.md). The root `CLAUDE.md` is a link to this file.
- `lb-*` skill entry links live in `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`, shared contract links in `docs/`; for the logbook format see [Logbook Format](docs/logbook-format.md).
- Files owned by this repository: the project logbook, this file, `lbkit-agents.yaml` (model, runtime, and collaboration parameters), and optionally `lbkit-skills.json` (a manifest of skills registered by kind of work, read and written by `bin/lb skills`).
